request.state:
Claim:
My policy number is OMI-6038873 and I have comprehensive cover, valid until 6 Sep 2026. On 9 May 2026 I hit another car in Dammam. The other driver, Yousef, is claiming against my policy. I have attached the traffic police accident report, the other car's registration (istimara), the at-fault driver's licence copy, photos of the damage to the other car and the Taqdeer assessment of the other car. The traffic police attended and issued report TP-81202793, which puts me at 100% fault. I have been your csutomer for 8 years. The other car's damage has been assessed at SR 48,500 in the assessment report. I'm writing on 2026-06-15 with an update on my claim. The driver's licence expired on 2026-03-14 and was renewed on 12 Jun 2026. I first reported this claim to you on 2026-05-20.

complexity.instructions: A customer ticket asks a motor-insurance claims desk to decide a claim (approve, partial, deny or need more information) and the payout. How hard is it to decide this claim correctly?

criteria.simple: one clear situation; a single rule decides it; at most one simple calculation
criteria.moderate: a payout calculation with a deductible or a fault share, or one exclusion to check
criteria.complex: several interacting conditions: exclusions or licence/authorisation questions, caps or total loss, conflicting or missing documents or amounts, late reporting, unusual parties

needs_calculation.instructions: Does deciding this claim require calculating a payout amount?

missing_information.instructions: Is information or a document needed to decide this claim missing?
